style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly: a solid, fixed modular block with a latched cover securely locked in place, positioned directly in front of a sleek, interchangeable modular cartridge slot. Studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop, matte surfaces with fine moulding seams and realistic contact shadows. Single soft key light, matte muted palette of soft grey and pale blue, generous editorial negative space. Minimalist, structural, precise.
negative_prompt: text, typography, numbers, letters, watermarks, logos, plain spheres, simple boxes, messy wires, people, hands
rationale: The story is about a structural, abstract shift in how code is assembled to manage costs. A clay render of a modular mechanical assembly perfectly visualizes the 'boundary' concept without resorting to generic server photos.
subject: a modular component assembly showing a fixed block and an interchangeable slot
alt_text: A matte modular mechanical assembly with a fixed block and an interchangeable cartridge slot on a neutral backdrop.
caption: The cache boundary forces developers to strictly separate static instructions from dynamic inputs.
title: Cache Boundary Assembly
